subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, explicit backed-up reset/repair, or automatic startup quarantine?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but recovery may move or discard persisted session continuity, so automation should not choose the product safety boundary.

options.title: Explicit Backed-Up Repair
options.body: Status/doctor reports the corrupt or oversized artifact and offers a user-confirmed backed-up reset or repair command.

options.title: Diagnostic-Only First
options.body: Status/doctor surfaces file health and manual guidance without moving or recreating state yet.

options.title: Automatic Quarantine
options.body: Startup moves bad state aside and recreates it automatically, accepting stronger recovery power and higher state-continuity risk.

recommendation.title: Explicit Backed-Up Repair
recommendation.body: Status/doctor reports the corrupt or oversized artifact and offers a user-confirmed backed-up reset or repair command.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent-history connection across the session-loader and Telegram status files involved in the policy choice.
